question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is **option 3) i.e., 'mind'. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let us look into the meaning of the given options - • **brain - **an organ of soft nervous tissue contained in the skull of vertebrates, functioning as the coordinating centre of sensation and intellectual and nervous activity. (दिमाग) • **thought - **an idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind. (विचार) • **mind - **a particular way of thinking, influenced by a person's profession or environment. (मन) • **head - **the upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs. (सिर) • The given blank needs a word that would explain the principal's view. • Thus, **option 3 or mind ** is the best fit word for the given blank. So the correct passage would be:- *Lin Piao used to absent himself (1) from classes very often and one day (2) the principal of the college made up his **(3) mind** to expel him. So he sent for the (4)_______ man. Lin arrived just (5)___________ the principal was about to go for lunch. "Is this the time to come?" said the principal, sternly.* 45:Td75,
